projects.label: 02 — Selected work
projects.heading: Selected projects
projects.subheading: Case studies from products I've helped build, end to end — not a wall of repositories.

agentCockpit.name: Agent Cockpit
agentCockpit.description: A local-first control room for developers running multiple Claude Code and Codex agents at once — session management, approvals, diffs, timeline replay and memory editing in a single interface, with no manual hook setup.
agentCockpit.contribution: Worked on the Claude Code integration layer: session resume and lifecycle handling, token-usage visualization, and the session history UI, including comparison and delete actions.
challenges: Keeping a local daemon in sync with multiple concurrent agent sessions over WebSockets
Rebuilding Claude session resume without relying on manual hook setup
Visualizing token usage and session history so it stays legible during long-running sessions

algoflow.name: AlgoFlow
algoflow.description: An interactive algorithm visualizer with real, step-by-step code execution — 31 algorithms across sorting, searching, data structures and dynamic programming, traced live across 8 languages from Python to Go and C++.
algoflow.contribution: Built the Code Tutor execution flow and contributed B-tree variations and extensible hashing to the data-structures visualizer.
challenges: Tracing real execution — GDB for C/Go, the V8 inspector for JS/TS, source instrumentation for Java/C# — behind one consistent visualizer
Extending the data-structures module with B-tree variants and extensible hashing
Keeping the execution sandbox reproducible across 8 languages with Docker

postable.name: Postable
postable.description: A SaaS platform that helps Brazilian small businesses plan and generate social-media content — analyzing brand context, local trends and competitive gaps to produce platform-specific posts.
postable.contribution: Built social-account integration and the posting flow — connecting, syncing and queuing posts across platforms — plus account-facing features on the Next.js frontend.
challenges: Coordinating a three-service architecture — Next.js frontend, Go backend, Python AI service — around one content-generation flow
Syncing OAuth-connected social accounts and handling pending or partial connection states
Streaming AI-generated content back to the client over SSE

hostly.name: Hostly
hostly.description: A full-stack seasonal-rental management platform with a persistence layer built entirely from scratch in Go — no traditional DBMS underneath.
hostly.contribution: Owned authentication and user-type routing, redesigned the frontend, added map-based property search, and worked across the backend — including XOR password encryption and KMP/BM search.
challenges: Replacing a traditional database with binary-file persistence, tombstones and a custom .hbak backup format
Implementing extensible hashing, B+ Trees and external merge sort for on-disk indexing and sorting
Adding Huffman/LZW compression and KMP/BM search on top of the custom storage engine

about.label: 05 — About
about.heading: About
about.paragraph: I'm a Computer Science student at PUC Minas focused on software engineering and full-stack product development. I enjoy working across the stack — from React and Next.js interfaces to APIs and backend systems in Go, Python and Java. My projects tend to sit where product engineering meets deeper technical problems: AI-agent orchestration, code execution, custom data structures, automation and cloud integrations.
